summary: one Postgres + one Node process handles **~57 claims/s** (57x today's 1 claim/s, plus 617 heartbeats/s) **before claim p95 > 50 ms** on this laptop (p95 19.3 ms there; 1111.5 ms at 75/s). The limit is the 20-connection pg pool waiting on the single Node event loop (connections idle in transaction), not Postgres: at 75/s only 1.1 backends were executing on average, and a 50-connection pool brought p95 back to 37.0 ms. 1x: claim p95 23.8 ms; 10x: 15.9 ms; 100x: 5099.3 ms with 21 failed requests.

The limit is the 20-connection pg pool waiting on the single Node event loop (connections idle in transaction), not Postgres: at 75/s only 1.1 backends were executing on average, and a 50-connection pool brought p95 back to 37.0 ms. 1x: claim p95 23.8 ms; 10x: 15.9 ms; 100x: 5099.3 ms with 21 failed requests.
